final: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE observstation IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT sc.observstation, sc.telescope_count, CAST(sc.telescope_count AS REAL) / totals.total_count AS share FROM station_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_count FROM station_counts) AS totals WHERE totals.total_count IS NOT NULL), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT shares.telescope_count, shares.share, shares.share - avg_share.average_share AS excess FROM shares CROSS JOIN avg_share WHERE avg_share.average_share IS NOT NULL AND shares.share > avg_share.average_share) SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(excess) AS average_excess FROM kept
